coachEvents.text: Jab, rear uppercut, lead hook, cross — straight time, eight bars. Jab, rear uppercut, lead hook, cross. Rise through the rear uppercut, turn the lead hook.
Lead uppercut, rear uppercut, lead uppercut — time-and-a-half, sixteen bars. Lead uppercut, rear uppercut, lead uppercut. Three short shots and a reset.
Jab, lead uppercut, cross — double-time, seventeen bars. Jab, lead uppercut, cross. Fast and compact, then stop.
